title: src/glovebox
subtitle: The gate: bearer token, four read tools (list, count, group, topic IDs), fixture mail source, SQLite store and the output validator

nodes.label: ReadTool
nodes.sub: list, count, group items; list topics

evidence.note: Only the acceptance tests' MCP client connects today; inferred as the agent.
Outermost middleware; compares the bearer token before anything else runs and records the caller's identity that page cursors are bound to.
Low-level Server with only tools/list and tools/call handlers: no resources or prompts.
Validates the call's inputs, checks the cursor, classifies the items that need it (see classifier.json), then answers from the store; the sort orders, filters and the 1000+ cap live in store.py.
Reads GLOVEBOX_HOST and GLOVEBOX_PORT, builds the app from the environment.
The only code that sees raw upstream structure; reads an item's subject and body only for the classifier, never to store or serve.
Permitted fields, semantic fields, keyed-digest handle and content mappings and sync state; no raw text. Mail outside the 30-day window is not stored.
Checks the whole result; a failure becomes the fixed response_invalid error.
add_middleware makes the token check the outermost layer of the app.
